text:
Maria G: Morning — async update from me. Did a credential sweep on prod cluster last night, rotated one aging KMS key (rk-prod-01), and ran smoke tests. Found 2 services still using the old key ID (svc-realtime, svc-metrics).

Elaine P: thx Maria. Where did those bindings show up? IAM role or inline key policy?

Maria G: inline key policy on svc-metrics, IAM role on svc-realtime. I left a note in the infra ticket with exact resource ARNs. PR drafted to update role binding: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/278 — needs review.

Raj K: can take the PR in a bit. quick question: did the smoke tests exercise KV cache ACLs? we had a regression there last month.

Maria G: yes exercised basic read/write; no regressions observed. I flagged deeper KV permission tests in the ticket (integration-run required).

sec-bot: Rotation job completed: key rk-prod-01 -> rk-prod-01-v2 (dry-run=false). Findings: 2 dependent services with stale key refs. See ticket #ISS-912. :white_check_mark:

Lucas H: FYI I saw a related Snyk vuln (high) for the metrics exporter yesterday — not sure if it impacts svc-metrics but raising because it coincides with the same deploy window. I added it to the audit board.

Maria G: thanks Lucas — linking SNYK-2026-453 to ISS-912. Blocker for me: need one more approver on the infra PR before I can apply the live role change during our 02:00 UTC maintenance window.

Elaine P: I can approve after morning sync. Raj to you for second?

Raj K: will review in 20 mins. Also question for oncall: if the live rotation causes issue, what's rollback plan? Maria, can you paste the rollback steps?

Maria G: rollback is simple: reassign old key alias to services and reapply previous policy — steps in ticket, here's the command snippet I used in dry-run:

```bash
# switch alias back
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/rk-prod --target-key-id <old-key-id>
# reapply policy from snapshot
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id <old-key-id> --policy file://policy-snapshot.json
```

Elaine P: perfect. I'll tag infra-ops to monitor the window and add a short runbook note in the ticket.

Raj K: PR reviewed, left minor comment about role name formatting. once that's cleaned up i'll approve.

Maria G: fixed and pushed. Thanks Raj! tagging @Elaine P and @Lucas H for final signoffs.

Lucas H: approved from my side (metrics vuln triage in parallel). Good to go for the maintenance window.

sec-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2026-03-18T02:00Z — auto-notifications will go out 30m prior.

Maria G: short follow-up: I also kicked off a quick baseline audit for service account permissions (script placed in infra/tools/sa-audit). If anyone wants to run locally: `python3 tools/sa_audit.py --env prod --output issues.json`

Elaine P: nice, will run and double-check later today. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
